infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Floomingo uses your photo library so you can select and upload photos to your travel posts, reviews, and profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Floomingo saves edited or generated travel images to your photo library when you choose to save them.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Floomingo uses your camera so you can take photos and videos for travel posts, reviews, and your profile.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Floomingo uses your microphone so you can record audio when creating videos and other content in the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Floomingo uses your location while you use the app to show nearby destinations and travel recommendations.
